decisions.reason: The supplement range builds directly on the firm's consumer health, pharmacy distribution and quality-control knowledge, so management can read early results and improve the line in-house.
The skin and hair supplement is a close extension of the established pharmacy supplement offer, which lets the firm absorb market feedback and adjust it with little extra knowledge needed.
The joint health product sits within the existing Trivital brand family and draws on familiar formulation and marketing know-how, so it fits the firm's absorptive base well.

The mushroom-based immune supplement is a more niche formulation with only minimal web presence, but it still relies on the firm's related supplement knowledge, so management keeps it while watching results.

The generic valsartan is distant from the firm's core knowledge and was hit by the 2018 nitrosamine recall, which makes the API-supply and regulatory problems hard for the firm to interpret and fix, so resources are better redirected.
